title: Strict Cost–$\ell^2$-Betti Inequalities for Free Group Actions
exact_target: Does there exist an infinite group with a free probability-measure-preserving action $\Gamma\curvearrowright(X,\mu)$ such that $\beta_1^{(2)}(\Gamma)<\operatorname{cost}(R_{\Gamma\curvearrowright(X,\mu)})-1$?
